# World of Chips

> Explore potato chip culture across 28 documented countries (and growing). Discover brands, flavors, market data, and snacking traditions from Japan to Peru.

World of Chips is an independent guide to potato chip culture around the world: leading brands, popular and unique flavors, snacking occasions and where to buy chips from 28 countries, plus buyer's guides and chip news. Some links are Amazon affiliate links (World of Chips earns from qualifying purchases).

## Main

- [World of Chips: Global Chip Map](https://worldofchips.com/): Interactive world map and overview of every country guide.
- [Potato Chip News: New Flavors, Recalls & Industry Moves](https://worldofchips.com/news/): Potato chip and crisps news from around the world, updated weekly: new flavor launches, food-safety recalls, industry deals and regional snack trends. Updated 20 Oct 2026.
